summary: Farmer Bros. filed an 8-K supplementing its proxy statement for a proposed merger with Royal Cup, Inc. via merger sub BP I Brew Merger Sub Inc., where Merger Sub will merge into Farmer Bros. and the company will survive. The supplement clarifies 401(k) plan share voting procedures for the special meeting, with unvoted shares voted in proportion to directed shares by April 28, 2026. No price per share, premium, or advisor is disclosed here; the proxy statement contains full terms. The deal is pending shareholder vote. Watch for vote outcome and regulatory clearance to assess closing risk.
